rationale
All terms refer to one collective note family. USD principal and fractional annual rates/day denominator are intentionally transformed into the stated unit. Where dates differ, note principal is held unchanged only under the explicit no-payment assumption; claimed amounts are comparisons/components, not verified account balances. Date interval and inclusion choices are explicit.

status
conditional
assumptions
  • One undivided note principal for the two named makers; no individual allocation or regulated-person identity inference.
  • January11 is assumed accrual start; note as-of date is not proof of a new cash advance.
  • Unchanged principal and no payments/fees assumed, consistent with creditor allegation but no transaction ledger supplied.
  • Annual compounding treated as capitalization on anniversary of note date; before January11 2019 there is no completed annual compounding boundary.
  • Fractional-year accrual uses actual days/360; no fractional exponent or daily compounding.
  • Accrual interval [start,end): start included, endpoint excluded; equivalent day count to excluding start and including end.
missing_inputs
  • Actual payment ledger
  • Express day-inclusion convention
  • Express fractional-year/rounding convention
purpose
Conditional regular-rate interest for 235 elapsed days ending 2018-09-03.

assumptions
  • One undivided note principal for the two named makers; no individual allocation or regulated-person identity inference.
  • January11 is assumed accrual start; note as-of date is not proof of a new cash advance.
  • Unchanged principal and no payments/fees assumed, consistent with creditor allegation but no transaction ledger supplied.
  • Annual compounding treated as capitalization on anniversary of note date; before January11 2019 there is no completed annual compounding boundary.
  • Fractional-year accrual uses actual days/360; no fractional exponent or daily compounding.
  • 10% until switch date 2018-09-19,15% thereafter; shared switch boundary counted once.
  • 15% replaces10% for default interval rather than adding on top; no interest capitalization at maturity or rate switch.
missing_inputs
  • Verified NY legal/bank holiday calendar
  • Applicable cure counting/inclusion convention
  • Actual ledger/no earlier transfer
  • Resolved notice/waiver/election interpretation where material

status
conditional
calculation_ids
  • calc-opeh-regular-holiday
  • calc-opeh-switch-19-interest
  • calc-opeh-switch-19-total
  • calc-opeh-rate-switch-day
assumptions
  • January11 is assumed accrual start; note as-of date is not proof of a new cash advance.
  • Unchanged principal and no payments/fees assumed, consistent with creditor allegation but no transaction ledger supplied.
  • Annual compounding treated as capitalization on anniversary of note date; before January11 2019 there is no completed annual compounding boundary.
  • Fractional-year accrual uses actual days/360; no fractional exponent or daily compounding.
  • No earlier property sale/transfer.
  • Due date excluded; count next ten Monday-Friday days, excluding only listed assumed holiday/closure dates.
  • Full tenth Business Day allowed; default-rate sensitivity begins next calendar day.
  • Rate-start construction conditional; notice/election/waiver relation not adjudicated.
missing_inputs
  • Verified applicable NewYork legal/bank holiday calendar
  • Actual transfer/payment history
  • Cure day inclusion and timing construction
  • Notice/election/waiver construction where material

statement
OPEH sought $2,233,007 principal, $155,070 accrued interest and additional interest against both named makers. The supplied later order marks the motion moot and case disposed by discontinuance; the attached notice discontinues without prejudice and without costs. The supplied disposition is not an award of the requested money and does not disclose settlement consideration, payment, release, or adjudication of the debt merits.
